verdict.rationale: Resend's create-API-key endpoint supports a `sending_access` permission that can only send emails. That key can be further restricted to a single domain, so a user can issue a least-privilege credential programmatically for an agent. The Vercel integration also auto-creates domain-linked keys, and key rotation is documented. Missing for 10: fine-grained per-resource scopes beyond the send-only vs full tiers, agent-specific credential guidance (e.g. for the MCP server), and independent hands-on corroboration of scoped-key use.
